title: 第一卷 第2641章 老登你怎么还没走啊第一卷 第2640章 吃着灵果看戏
content_zh:
圣火回灵丹的丹香还在丹房内弥漫不散，众人尚沉浸在两道丹纹带来的震撼之中，林尘却忽然皱起了眉头。
他将那枚绝品丹药托在掌心，翻来覆去端详了片刻，随即说出了一句让满场死寂的话。
“这圣火回灵丹的丹方，似乎有些问题。”
话音落下，王霖只觉得一股腥甜直冲喉头，差点当场喷出一口老血来。
他死死瞪着林尘，牙齿咬得咯吱作响，心说：你他娘的，丹药都已经好端端地炼制出来了，两道丹纹摆在那里，现在居然说丹方有问题？
丹方若真有毛病，又怎么可能顺顺利利把丹药炼成？而且还炼出了绝品？在王霖看来，林尘这话分明就是故意说给他听的，存心要往他伤口上撒盐。
赢了他的灵韵仙炉还不够，还要当着所有人的面再踩他一脚。
然而，林尘心里还真没有这个意思。
他方才将圣火回灵丹从头到尾炼制了一遍，对这张丹方的每一处细节都有了切身的体会。
正是在这个过程中，他敏锐地察觉到了丹方中隐藏的瑕疵——药材的君臣配伍在某个节点上略有偏移，火候转换的节奏也存在一丝微妙的失衡。
这些问题极其隐蔽，若非林尘丹道悟性逆天，又在炼丹时对每一个环节都体察入微，根本不可能发现。
他之前翻阅丹方时，只是将其当做一份炼制指南来参悟，没有刻意去审视丹方本身，因此有所忽略。
如今亲身实践了一遍，那一丝不对劲的感觉便从模糊变得清晰，最终变成了笃定的判断。
“我的判断不会有错，这张丹方确实存在缺陷。”
林尘语气平淡，像是在陈述一件再寻常不过的事情，“如果丹方没有问题的话，我理应能凝聚出第三道丹纹，甚至更多才对。
正是丹方本身的局限，让丹药在最后攀升品阶的时候受到了压制。”
闻言，李川张了张嘴，倒也没多说什么。
丹方到底有没有问题，他心里其实毫无概念——他李川又不是什么炼丹师，对丹道的认知仅限于吃丹药而已。
他扭头看了一眼在场的李家众人，从他们脸上读到了和自己差不多的茫然，以及一种微妙的、和王霖如出一辙的神情。
显然，在场大多数人心里都在嘀咕：林尘这小子，多半是在故意羞辱王霖。

林尘懒得多做解释，目光越过众人，落在脸色铁青的王霖身上，嘴角缓缓勾勒出一抹灿烂的弧度。
他不疾不徐地开口，声音不大，却每个字都像锤子一样敲在王霖心口上。
“行了，丹方到底有没有问题，我似乎也没必要跟你多费口舌。
老登，你现在要做的事情只有一件——把灵韵仙炉交出来。”
王霖浑身一震，双手死死攥住怀中那尊灵韵仙炉，指节因为用力过度而泛出青白色。
炉身温润的光泽映在他扭曲的面孔上，说不出的讽刺。
这尊仙炉跟了他不知多少年月，见证了他从一个无名丹师一步步走到今天的位置，说是命根子也毫不为过。
让他将灵韵仙炉交出去，简直比一刀杀了他还要难受百倍。
他只觉得胸口像被人生生剜去了一块肉，空落落的疼。
“这么多双眼睛都看着呢，”
林尘不紧不慢地补了一句，目光似笑非笑，“你该不会是想赖账吧？”
这一句话，将王霖最后一点侥幸也碾得粉碎。
他是光明教的元老，丹道领域的名宿，当着李家这么多强者的面，他丢不起这个人。
王霖胸口剧烈起伏了数次，一口气憋在喉咙里几乎要把自己噎死，终于，他猛一咬牙，将手中那尊仙炉狠狠往外一推。
“拿去！”
灵韵仙炉脱手的瞬间，王霖感觉自己的半条命都跟着一起飞了出去。
content_en:
The elixir fragrance of the Holy Fire Resurrection Pill still permeated the elixir room. Everyone was still immersed in the shock brought by the two elixir patterns, but Lin Chen suddenly frowned.
He held the top-quality elixir in his palm, turned it over and over for a moment, and then said something that made the whole place fall into silence.
"There seems to be something wrong with the formula of the Holy Fire Recovery Pill."
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Lin felt a sweetness rush straight into his throat, and he almost spat out a mouthful of blood on the spot.
He glared at Lin Chen, gritting his teeth, and said to himself: Damn you, the elixir has been refined perfectly, and the two elixir patterns are there, and now you are saying that there is something wrong with the elixir?
If there was something really wrong with the elixir recipe, how could it be possible to successfully refine the elixir? And he also made a perfect product? In Wang Lin's opinion, Lin Chen's words were clearly told to him on purpose, with the intention of rubbing salt into his wounds.
It's not enough to win his Spiritual Immortal Furnace, he has to step on him again in front of everyone.
However, Lin Chen really didn't have this intention in his heart.
He had just refined the Holy Fire Spirit-Rejuvenating Pill from beginning to end, and had a personal understanding of every detail of this pill recipe.
It was during this process that he was keenly aware of the hidden flaws in the elixir - the combination of medicinal materials was slightly offset at a certain point, and there was also a subtle imbalance in the rhythm of the heat transition.
These problems are extremely hidden, and it would have been impossible to discover them if it weren't for Lin Chen's incredible understanding of alchemy and his meticulous attention to every detail when refining the alchemy.
When he read the elixir recipe before, he only regarded it as a refining guide and did not deliberately examine the elixir recipe itself, so he ignored it.
Now that I have practiced it myself, the feeling that something was wrong has changed from vague to clear, and finally turned into a firm judgment.
"My judgment will not be wrong. This prescription does have flaws."
Lin Chen's tone was calm, as if he was stating an ordinary thing, "If there is no problem with the elixir recipe, I should be able to condense the third elixir pattern, or even more.
It was the limitations of the elixir itself that caused the elixir to be suppressed when it finally climbed up the grade. "
Hearing this, Li Chuan opened his mouth, but didn't say much.
He actually had no idea whether there was anything wrong with the elixir recipe - Li Chuan was not an alchemist, and his knowledge of elixirs was limited to taking elixirs.
He turned his head and glanced at the Li family present, and saw on their faces a look of confusion similar to his own, as well as a subtle look that was exactly the same as Wang Lin's.
Obviously, most of the people present were muttering in their hearts: Lin Chen was probably deliberately humiliating Wang Lin.
Lin Chen was too lazy to explain. He looked past the crowd and landed on Wang Lin, whose face was ashen. The corners of his mouth slowly drew a brilliant arc.
He spoke slowly and slowly, his voice was not loud, but every word hit Wang Lin's heart like a hammer.
"Okay, as to whether there is any problem with Danfang, I don't seem to need to waste any more words with you.
Lao Deng, there is only one thing you have to do now - hand over the Lingyun Immortal Furnace. "
Wang Lin's whole body was shaken, and he tightly grasped the spiritual furnace in his arms with both hands, his knuckles turning blue-white due to excessive exertion.
The warm luster of the furnace body reflected on his twisted face, showing unspeakable irony.
This immortal furnace has been with him for countless years and has witnessed his step-by-step transformation from an unknown alchemist to where he is today. It is no exaggeration to say that it is his lifeblood.
Asking him to hand over the Lingyun Immortal Furnace would be a hundred times more uncomfortable than killing him with a knife.
He only felt as if a piece of flesh had been cut out of his chest, and there was an empty pain.
"So many pairs of eyes are watching,"
Lin Chen added unhurriedly, with a half-smiling look in his eyes, "You don't want to default on the debt, do you?"
This sentence crushed Wang Lin's last bit of luck to pieces.
He is the elder of the Guangming Sect and a famous figure in the field of alchemy. In front of so many powerful people from the Li family, heHe couldn't afford to lose this person's face.
Wang Lin's chest rose and fell violently several times, and he almost choked himself to death with a breath held in his throat. Finally, he gritted his teeth and pushed out the fairy furnace in his hand.
"Take it!"
The moment the Lingyun Immortal Furnace was released, Wang Lin felt that half of his life flew out with it.
